name: vendoros
description: VendorOS - multi-tenant SaaS operating system for UAE manpower/fleet vendors

scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build:api && npm run build:web
scripts.lint: npm run lint --workspace=packages/shared && npm run lint --workspace=apps/api && npm run lint --workspace=apps/web
scripts.lint:fix: npm run lint --workspace=packages/shared -- --fix && npm run lint --workspace=apps/api -- --fix && npm run lint --workspace=apps/web -- --fix
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace=packages/shared && npm run typecheck --workspace=apps/api && npm run typecheck --workspace=apps/web
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace=packages/shared && npm run test --workspace=apps/api && npm run test --workspace=apps/web
scripts.verify: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build
scripts.clean: rm -rf node_modules apps/*/node_modules packages/*/node_modules apps/*/dist packages/*/dist apps/*/coverage
